name: altuu/plugin-attachment-bridge
description: NativePHP attachment download bridge with confirm, preview, and save actions

bridge_functions.name: AttachmentBridge.Download
bridge_functions.description: Download an attachment via native bridge and prompt user to preview or save

bridge_functions.name: AttachmentBridge.OpenURL
bridge_functions.description: Open any URL in an in-app browser with session cookies injected

bridge_functions.name: AttachmentBridge.OpenTronclass
bridge_functions.description: Open tronclass:// URL scheme in native app

bridge_functions.name: AttachmentBridge.OpenLocalFile
bridge_functions.description: Open a downloaded local file path via native preview or app chooser

bridge_functions.name: AttachmentBridge.PickDocument
bridge_functions.description: Open the system document picker, copy the chosen file into app storage and dispatch DocumentPicked / DocumentPickCancelled
